title: Shabe Ashoor hai Zehra
body:
shab-e-ashoor hai zehra
tadap kar kehti hai fizza
kunba pyasa hai zehra tera
door hai ab bohat dariya
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun pani pilayega
alatash ki sadae'n hai'n aur muqalif fizae'n hai'n
kya saji hai ye bazme aza
hur bhi aaya hai sunke azaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
di azaa'n akber e noujawa'n
naame rab aur unch huwa
raat guzregi din hoga
qafila sheh ke bin hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm had se siva hoga
aun bhi aur mohd gaye
ran me dono mujahid lade
rakh liya hai bharam deen ka
<<DIVIDER>>
qasime gul badan jaate hai
hoke pamaal wo aate hai
tukde tukde huwa dulha
sheh ke haathau pe bacha gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
teer khaake bhi asgher hansa
dekhta rah gaya hurmula
barchhi ke zad pe aaya jigar
khoon bhara ek tha manzar
<<DIVIDER>>
puchho to kaise lasha utha
paani laane ko ghazi gaye
pyaase bachau ki khatir diye
dono shano'n ko behre khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
kis qayamat ka hai ye sama
dekhti reh gayi fatima
kund khanjar gale par chala
nouha iqbal ne hai likha
<<DIVIDER>>
ek naya hogaya moujiza
aayi sunke ye ab fatima
